name: Progress M-06M
about: Progress M-06M (2010-033A), a crewed vehicle (Progress MM), launched 2010 Jun 30. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2010 Jul  2), held fixed
docked to S26400; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
